notes.title: Update is live. Patch 0.0.2
notes.notes:
The update we were talking about is now live. Hope you enjoy the game!

Here's what changed: 

New Features and removed stuff:

Added:
- Optimization (Game doesn't lag anymore)
- Real World Time (Now, you can explore this world at Real World Time in UTC Time Zone)
- New Character, weapon and AI system
- The new weapons includes: Flamethrower, molotov, smgs (mp5, micro uzi, ump45), Sniper Rifle, Rocket Launcher, better melee system, baseball bat, Assault rifles (Ak47, M4A1, Scoped AR)
- New vehicle system which includes new car models
- Intro screen and main menu

Removed and changed stuff:
- Changed the car models with the new ones
- Changed the park a little bit, there are less trees and no more invisble walls
- Removed the current vehicle system as well as the ability to seat on the back seat of the car as it was causing the fatal error.
- Changed the whole character system, which means that the animations are also changed and some other features like mantling etc.
- Removed the side missions temporarily as we are facing some issues with that as well and we are working on a fix.
- Minimap Removed temporarily

notes.title: Update will be up and available today!
notes.notes:
The update said we are working on will be up very soon. We have changed/removed some stuff and added some other features.

New Features and removed stuff:

Added:
- Optimization (Game doesn't lag anymore)
- Real World Time (Now, you can explore this world at Real World Time in UTC Time Zone)
- New Character, weapon and AI system
- The new weapons includes: Flamethrower, molotov, smgs (mp5, micro uzi, ump45), Sniper Rifle, Rocket Launcher, better melee system, baseball bat, Assault rifles (Ak47, M4A1, Scoped AR)
- New vehicle system which includes new car models
- Intro screen and main menu

Removed and changed stuff:
- Changed the car models with the new ones
- Changed the park a little bit, there are less trees and no more invisble walls
- Removed the current vehicle system as well as the ability to seat on the back seat of the car as it was causing the fatal error.
- Changed the whole character system, which means that the animations are also changed and some other features like mantling etc.
- Removed the side missions temporarily as we are facing some issues with that as well and we are working on a fix.
- Minimap Removed temporarily

NOTE: There's also an issue with the pause menu and we are working on it. The issue is that whenever you are trying to access the Key bindings menu from the Controls options and you click back, then the menu disappears when you try to access the menu again by pressing the Esc key.

We really apologize for the issues that the game had, we are trying our best to provide a great experience to everyone!

notes.title: Regarding Fatal Error issue!
notes.notes:
We were able to find out what causes the issue on the game and an update will probably be released in the upcoming days if nothing else shows up. We have changed the system of the game, we have temporarily removed some stuff as they were the reason that the Fatal Error issue is happening but they might be added again in a later update and the new update that we have might be released soon!

Yet again, we want to apologize to all of our players who had to experience issues inside the game, we are working on fixing them and we will try our best to give you the best experience possible so that you can enjoy the game! 

Thanks to everyone who are supporting us, we really appreciate it. We will keep updating the game as promised in the Early Access goals displayed on our game's store page!

notes.title: Be patient, something really good is coming about the game!
notes.notes: The reason we publishing this post is because we would first like to apologize for all of you who are experiencing the Fatal Error issue and would like to tell you that we will be changing the system of the game. What we mean by changing the system is that we will change character behavior, change gun models as the current system is probably what causes the issue. We are still trying to fix the problem and  will update the game soon. The meaning of the game is going to stay the same. Thanks to all of you who support us. We won't let you down, we will try our best to provide you the best experience possible!
